prose.text: The standard gate set runs in the test-plan §3 order. `capability-drift` precedes the default-features workspace nextest. The `--features mcp-server` bindings regen and the base-identity bindings close come last, since no procedure or type is added. The chunk's own entries come first: - the collection proof; - the targeted runs over `triage` + `interpretation` and over the probe example; - the probe build and its `--dry-run` reading; - the scope guard, the lockfile and print-site probes, and the English-sources gate.

Absences, each with its reason: - No `pulse-app/ui/**` path is touched, so the webview gates are absent. - No boot-path file is touched (`main.rs`, `observability.rs`, `crates/ui-bridge/src/`, `tauri.conf.json`,   `capabilities/*.json`; the scope guard proves it), so the boot smoke does not bind (test-plan §3 Boot-smoke gate).   The digest text changes ride `payload_summary` and add no boot record. - There is no harness live leg and no self-verify; the dry-run reading binds no port and spawns nothing. - No package is added, so `cargo deny` / `cargo audit` are not listed locally. The CI `supply-chain` job runs them, and   the operator CI read asserts it green.

**The gated criterion's entries** are the two `l4_decision_probe` real-model runs carrying `defer = "gated: …"`. They run only through `--void {n}:block cleared — {evidence}` once a Linux CUDA `llama-cli` exists. They are pre-registered here, before any run: rank1 ≥ 36/40 on `shipped`, `nf` recorded. Each needs the operator's model slot.

`cargo xtask pre-push:linux` cannot evaluate on this Linux host (`wsl.exe`, `xtask/src/pre_push.rs`). As in the predecessor chunks (founder deviation 2026-10-04), its six stages run NATIVELY by hand before the push, as the six `operator` entries after hygiene. Stage 5 re-emits the no-mcp bindings, so the regen and the base-identity close are RE-FIRED as `operator` entries after stage 6.

ONE-SHOT controls at /implement are never listed, because they mutate source and revert: Step 1's red-before-green run and Step 12's mutation checks. The listed, non-mutating pin entries guard the property on every re-run.
The CI read waits 2400 s, matching the predecessor's measured wall-clock (1717 s at `03fb097`); its timeout is 2580.

The `--features mcp-server` bindings regen and the base-identity bindings close come last, since no procedure or type is added. The chunk's own entries come first: - the collection proof; - the targeted runs over `triage` + `interpretation` and over the probe example; - the probe build and its `--dry-run` reading; - the scope guard, the lockfile and print-site probes, and the English-sources gate.

The digest text changes ride `payload_summary` and add no boot record. - There is no harness live leg and no self-verify; the dry-run reading binds no port and spawns nothing. - No package is added, so `cargo deny` / `cargo audit` are not listed locally. The CI `supply-chain` job runs them, and   the operator CI read asserts it green.

**The gated criterion's entries** are the two `l4_decision_probe` real-model runs carrying `defer = "gated: …"`. They run only through `--void {n}:block cleared — {evidence}` once a Linux CUDA `llama-cli` exists. They are pre-registered here, before any run: rank1 ≥ 36/40 on `shipped`, `nf` recorded. Each needs the operator's model slot.
